$description: Typography the design system adds to the Figma library: the icon font and its axes, line heights and letter spacing. Not in the Figma library: added by the design system.

icon.$description: Icon font: Material Symbols Outlined, latest version served by Google Fonts. The axes (fill, weight, grade, optical size) are fixed: web/fonts.css requests exactly these values, change both together.

fill.$description: FILL axis: 0 is the outlined glyph, 1 the filled one.

grade.$description: GRAD axis: stroke thickness without changing the glyph size.

optical-size.$description: opsz axis, in px: the size the glyph strokes are drawn for.

line-height.$description: Line heights as multipliers of the font size.

compact.$description: The line box equals the font size: single-line labels set as in the Figma prototype (Button).

tight.$description: Negative tracking of the Figma prototype's button labels: -2 % of body.size.xs and body.size.sm, -3 % of body.size.md, written in px (the token format has no em).
